title: Tom and Lily Play
text:
Tom has a toy car. It is blue and very fast. He plays with the car in his room. His sister has a doll named Lily.

Every Sunday, Tom and Lily play a board game. They roll the dice and move their pieces. Lily always wins. Tom laughs and says let's play again.

questions.text: What color is Tom's toy car?
What does Lily always do in the board game?
How does Tom probably feel when Lily wins?
Why does Tom want to play again?
options: He enjoys the game with his sister
He wants to go to school
He has no room to play

vocabulary.definition: an object that children play with
small cubes with numbers on each side, used in games

paragraph_translations: Tom ma zabawkowe autko. Jest niebieskie i bardzo szybkie. Bawi się autkiem w swoim pokoju. Jego siostra ma lalkę o imieniu Lily.
Każdej niedzieli Tom i Lily grają w grę planszową. Rzucają kostkami i przesuwają swoje pionki. Lily zawsze wygrywa. Tom się śmieje i mówi, żeby zagrali jeszcze raz.
